summary: An announcement that the next Network Graphics meeting would run from the evening of Sunday November 21 to Tuesday November 23, 1971, hosted by the Stanford Artificial Intelligence Project.

plainLanguage.summary: This one-page RFC announces the dates and host for the next Network Graphics meeting. It says additional information will be provided later.

questions: when was the next network graphics meeting scheduled
where was the network graphics meeting hosted
subtitle: An announcement of the next Network Graphics meeting.

tldr.problem: The Network Graphics group needed to know when and where its next meeting would take place.
tldr.mechanism: The announcement schedules the meeting to begin the evening of Sunday, November 21, and adjourn Tuesday, November 23, at the Stanford Artificial Intelligence Project.
tldr.outcome: Further information is to come from Andy Moorer of Stanford AI.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 246 as Unknown and records no RFC that updates or obsoletes it. It is a historical Network Graphics meeting announcement.

sections.title: Meeting Dates and Host
sections.content: The next Network Graphics meeting is scheduled to begin the evening of Sunday, November 21, and adjourn Tuesday, November 23. The Stanford Artificial Intelligence Project will host it.
sections.plainLanguage: The meeting is scheduled to begin on Sunday evening, November 21, and end on Tuesday, November 23. The Stanford Artificial Intelligence Project will host it.

sections.title: Further Information
sections.content: The announcement says additional information will come from Andy Moorer of Stanford AI. It gives no agenda or other meeting details.
sections.plainLanguage: Andy Moorer is named as the source of further details. This announcement does not include an agenda.

sections.title: Scope of the Announcement
sections.content: This RFC is a brief meeting announcement rather than a technical proposal. Its unit metadata lists the status as Unknown and records no RFC updates or replacements.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC announces a meeting; it does not define a graphics protocol. The metadata lists its status as Unknown.
